name: meetings
description: Hub-centric meeting notes: one Meetings Hub per day at spice/meetings/hubs/YYYY/MM-MMMM/ aggregating individual meeting notes at spice/meetings/notes/ via MeetingsHubCards CustomJS class + entity-create@0.1.0 button. v0.1.2: filename pattern <Name>-YYYY-MM-DD (Meetings-YYYY-MM-DD.md hub; <title>-YYYY-MM-DD.md per-meeting); hub folder date-routed; class regex date-extract. v0.2.0: MeetingsHubCards migrated to BeaconCards via row layout + async pre-fetch adapter; per-badge SVG icons + secondaryText subtitle preserved end-to-end. v0.3.0 MINOR: pilot integration with people-rendering@0.1.0 mechanism — MeetingsHubCards subtitle slot renders attendee chips for registered People (those with spice/people/<name>.md notes) via PeopleRendering.renderChip callback (uses cards@0.2.4 subtitle-callback polymorphism); falls back to comma-string when no registered People; new ## Attendees chip-rendering dataviewjs block in Meeting.md template above the bullet list. Attendee autocomplete deferred to v0.27.x carry. v0.4.0 MINOR (v0.33.0 wave 2): adopts claude_surface[] — ships canonical /meetings slash command + new-meeting SKILL.md + resolvers row. v0.5.0 MINOR: inline create-button class deleted; manifest declares new_entity_buttons[] via entity-create@0.1.0 mechanism; Meeting Hub template now uses entity-create marker. v0.5.0 follow-up: removed body_template (Meeting.md Templater syntax incompatible with entity-create); frontmatter_template carries the static-known fields (date/type/summary/attendees/tags/cssclasses); inline_body carries the SpaceNavButtons block. Existing Meeting.md template stays in files[] for manual user 'Insert template' invocation. v0.7.0 MINOR (v0.88.0 people-cohesion-1): Templater Meeting.md template gains a suggester-loop over existing spice/people/*.md (plus + Add new person… and Done sentinels), replacing the free-text Attendees prompt. people: frontmatter array now mirrors attendees: at creation (one-way mirror; user can append discussed-but-absent people manually). people: is the superset (attendees + people referenced); attendees: stays the canonical at-the-meeting field — validator rule unchanged. Button-driven new_entity_buttons[0] path unchanged (deferred to v0.89.0+ when entity-create gains a people-multi prompt type). v0.8.0 MINOR (v0.102.0 S3): adds optional 'Project (optional)' select prompt to the meeting + New flow via entity-create@0.5.0's options_source: "all_projects" — resolves at prompt-render-time to the list of all type:project notes plus a "(none)" sentinel; selecting a project wraps the answer as a wikilink, selecting (none) yields empty string. New frontmatter_template field 'project' carries the link or stays empty when unaffiliated. MeetingsHubCards now prepends a [Project Name] pill in the row meta slot when project: is set, providing a visual reinforcement of the bidirectional link surfaced on the Project note's ## Meetings panel (project blueprint v1.16.0). v0.10.0 MINOR (v0.125.0 MeetingLeafActions): new MeetingLeafActions CustomJS class (helpers/meeting-leaf-actions.js) renders a leaf-note action row on each meeting note — New Task / Add to Project / Edit Attendees — invoked from the Meeting.md template; install.js heal injects the action-row block into existing meeting leaf notes that predate the class. v0.11.0 MINOR (v0.126.0 button inline_body parity): the v0.5.0-stripped new_entity_buttons[0].inline_body is promoted to chrome parity with the Templater Meeting.md template — Breadcrumb + SpaceNavButtons + MeetingLeafActions + Attendees (top SectionLabel + PeopleRendering chip block) + Agenda/Notes/Action Items SectionLabels — so button-created meetings receive the same static-renderable chrome as Templater-created meetings. Templater-only pieces (attendee suggester loop + attendee-driven bullet list) stay in the Templater path. Closes the v0.125.0 omission where MeetingLeafActions was added to the template + heal but not to the button creation path. v0.11.1 PATCH (v0.126.1 MeetingLeafActions polish): six bug fixes after v0.126.0 real-user repro. (1) PeopleRendering snackbar — both Meeting.md template AND inline_body had `args: [dv, {mode...}, {style}]` but customjs-guard already prepends dv → method received (dv, dv, {mode}, {style}) → query bound to second dv → 'unknown mode undefined' Notice every render. Pre-existing since v0.88.0 PeopleRendering pilot; v0.126.0 spread it to button-created meetings. Drop the leading dv from args. (2) Edit Attendees search input wired to live-filter the people list. (3) Add button gated on no-exact-match + dynamic label 'Add "X" as new person' — prevents silent stub creation. (4) Drop the orphan `-` bullet stub between PeopleRendering chip block and Agenda SectionLabel (chips are canonical attendees display). (5) Sections-vanish-after-return investigated — incidental fix from (1). (6) `---` dividers added around MeetingLeafActions block per note-chrome grammar. v0.12.0 MINOR (v0.127.0 task-interactions wave): MeetingLeafActions._onNewTask rewritten to dual-write — appends the task to the meeting note's Action Items section AND, when frontmatter project: is set, to the project's <Project> To-Do.md — replacing the v0.125.0 ToDoCreateTask one-shot delegation (which routed to today's daily To-Do instead of the meeting). New ACTION_ITEMS_MARKER sentinel (<!-- ACTION_ITEMS_MARKER -->) lands in the template + new_entity_buttons[0].inline_body immediately before the Action Items SectionLabel block; it's the stable anchor task-interactions@0.1.0's appendTask() locates for inserts. Depends_on +1 task-interactions@>=0.1.0. New helpers in meeting-leaf-actions.js: _openTaskModal (replaces the ToDoCreateTask.open call), _projectTodoPath (resolves the meeting's project to spice/projects/<slug>/<Name> To-Do.md), _noticeDualWrite (5 Notice variants covering meeting-only / dual / project-missing / failure paths).

new_entity_buttons.label: New Meeting

post_install.message: Meetings blueprint installed at spice/meetings/. REQUIRED: enable the Templater community plugin if not already enabled. Click 'Meetings' to open today's meetings hub at spice/meetings/hubs/YYYY-MM-DD-Meetings.md. From the hub, click 'New Meeting' (powered by entity-create@0.1.0) to create individual meeting notes at spice/meetings/notes/YYYY/MM-MMMM/YYYY-MM-DD <title>.md (you'll be prompted for title). Hub renders today's meetings as cards with status badges; meetings also appear in the daily dashboard's Today's Meetings panel.
